explanationMd: Since 0.01=10 to the minus two, its base-ten logarithm is −2. Logarithms of positive numbers below one are negative when the base exceeds one.

distractorRationale.d: This confuses a negative exponent with a fractional one.
distractorRationale.c: This ignores that the argument is below 1.
distractorRationale.a: A logarithm is an exponent, not the negative reciprocal.
